rationale: All 5 blocking findings from code-review.final resolved with concrete fix-up commits and verified with passing tests: CR-001 migration now uses server_default=sa.false() (nullable=False) so pre-existing rows backfill to false instead of NULL; CR-002 both missed paginated read paths (get_user_conversations_paginated, get_conversation_history_slice) now select/populate is_finished/finished_at, covered by 2 new tests; CR-003 (decision_needed) resolved per user's explicit choice to keep snake_case on ConversationListItem/ConversationResponse and correct spec.md's inaccurate camelCase claim rather than force a breaking DTO change; CR-004 isFinished query param now wired through both the paginated and non-paginated branches of GET /conversations, covered by 2 new tests; CR-005 (decision_needed) resolved per user's explicit choice to add a targeted DB-freshness recheck (assert_mutable(recheck_db=True)) immediately before persist in all 5 guarded write paths, covered by 5 new tests proving the recheck fires when a concurrent finish committed after the in-memory load. No new high-risk issues suspected in the fix-up diff (all 5 changes are narrow, additive, and covered by tests); skipped the optional confirmation-pass lens dispatch on that basis. Full targeted regression (170 tests) and both make ruff / make license-check gates pass clean after the fix-up.

business_review.item: Conversation.is_finished column added (Optional[bool], default False, Boolean sa_column)
Conversation.finished_at column added as tz-aware DateTime per spec snippet
business_review.notes: Implemented as plain (non-tz-aware) datetime, deliberately matching the existing date/update_date columns' convention on this table (documented rationale in plan.md) rather than the spec's literal snippet. Dismissed as a deliberate, reasoned deviation, not a defect.

business_review.item: Alembic migration adds is_finished/finished_at columns and ix_conversations_unfinished partial index on (date) WHERE is_finished = false
business_review.notes: 67b7c43d6090_add_is_finished_to_conversations.py — columns and partial index created as specified.

business_review.item: Partial index safe/correct for scheduler discovery (isFinished=false), mirroring is_workflow_conversation precedent
business_review.notes: See CR-001 — no server_default/backfill means pre-migration rows get is_finished=NULL, which the partial index predicate and every equality filter silently exclude.

business_review.item: ConversationListItem and ConversationResponse gain is_finished/finished_at fields
business_review.notes: conversation.py — fields added to both DTOs.

business_review.item: New fields serialize as isFinished/finishedAt via the existing ConfiguredModel camelCase alias convention
business_review.notes: See CR-003 — both DTOs are plain BaseModel with no alias generator; they emit snake_case, unlike the new finish-endpoint DTOs which do use ConfiguredModel.

business_review.item: AC5: every conversation read/list response surfaces is_finished/finished_at
business_review.notes: See CR-002 — get_user_conversations_paginated and get_conversation_history_slice (paginated GET branches) were not updated and always report isFinished=false.

business_review.item: _build_filter_sql allowed_filter_columns gains is_finished, usable as user list-endpoint query filter isFinished=true|false (AC6)
business_review.notes: See CR-004 — the filter column is allowed but no route passes an isFinished query param through to get_user_conversations.

business_review.item: New GET /admin/conversations endpoint: paginated, filterable, admin-only, returns PaginatedListResponse[ConversationListItem], backed by get_all_conversations_admin
business_review.notes: admin.py implements exactly this shape; admin-only enforced via router-level dependencies.
Verified end to end in conversation.py + conversation_service.py.

business_review.item: POST /admin/conversations/{id}/finish (admin): no ownership check, router-level admin gate
business_review.notes: admin.py wires require_ownership=False; router dependency covers auth.

business_review.item: POST /admin/conversations/finish-bulk: request/response shapes and not-all-or-nothing per-ID semantics
business_review.notes: ConversationFinishBulkRequest/Response and finish_conversations_bulk match the spec exactly.

business_review.item: Conversation.assert_mutable() raises 409 with specified message/details/help text
All 5 documented content-mutation call sites guarded by assert_mutable() as first check
business_review.notes: Verified all 5 call sites individually, including the ExtendedHTTPException re-raise guard in WorkflowService.create_workflow_execution's except chain.

business_review.item: Enforcement excludes metadata ops (pin/rename/folder/share, add_feedback/remove_feedback) and delete_conversation_by_id
business_review.notes: None of these are touched by the diff, consistent with spec's explicit out-of-scope list.

business_review.item: No locking added for the finish/mutate race (explicitly accepted)
business_review.notes: No lock primitives added; consistent with spec. Note CR-005 flags a more severe variant of this accepted risk for a decision.

business_review.item: Testing: extend the 6 listed test files/suites
business_review.notes: 5 of 6 extended; test_ability_conversation.py untouched (deferred — reuses already-tested Ability.can(WRITE,...) primitive, and 403/200 paths are directly tested at router/service level).

standards_review.notes: All 10 commits use 'EPMCDME-11067: <lowercase verb> ...' while repo convention (git-workflow.md, confirmed against 20 recent main commits) capitalizes the first word after the colon, e.g. 'EPMCDME-13794: Fix ...'. Cosmetic, not blocking.
make ruff and make license-check both pass cleanly; full targeted regression suite (159 tests) passes.
Router-level admin_access_only dependency confirmed to cover all 3 new admin routes; raw SQL uses bound params via text().bindparams(); no hardcoded secrets or injection vectors introduced.

finding_status.notes: server_default=sa.false() + nullable=False added to the migration; syntax-verified, matches repo precedent (k6l7m8n9o0p1_add_workflow_marketplace_columns.py).

is_finished/finished_at added to get_user_conversations_paginated's SELECT+construction and get_conversation_history_slice's meta_stmt SELECT; 2 new passing tests (test_returns_is_finished_in_list_items, test_returns_is_finished_in_conversation).

User decision: keep ConversationListItem/ConversationResponse snake_case (no breaking DTO change); spec.md's Data model and Scope sections corrected to state the actual casing and the reasoning for keeping it. No code change required or made.

isFinished Query param added to get_conversation_list; forwarded as filters={'is_finished': ...} to Conversation.get_user_conversations (non-paginated branch) and as is_finished=... to ConversationService.get_user_conversations_paginated (paginated branch, which also gained the WHERE clause support); 2 new passing tests.

User decision: add a targeted guard. Conversation.assert_mutable(recheck_db=True) added with a new _is_finished_in_db lightweight scalar-column lookup; wired immediately before the final persist call in all 5 guarded write paths (upsert_chat_history, upsert_conversation_with_history, update_conversation_ai_message, WorkflowService.create_workflow_execution's chat-execution branch, WorkflowService.append_user_message_on_resume); 5 new passing tests proving 409 fires on a simulated concurrent-finish race.
